events.verdict: Robinson-Earl (NOP) briefly engages and separates from Davis (LAL) as they move in the same direction following the pick.
Ingram (NOP) releases from Reaves (LAL) without extending or applying force during his step back at the end of his drive.
Reaves (LAL) contests Ingram's (NOP) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
The ball is deflected by Knecht (LAL), but it does not go out of bounds. Based on the out-of-bounds call, the ball should have been awarded to NOP.
Robinson-Earl (NOP) briefly engages with Davis (LAL) as Davis rolls toward the basket following the pick.
Davis (LAL) dislodges the ball from Ingram (NOP) and deflects it out of bounds.
James (LAL) attempts to go for the steal and initiates contact with Ingram's (NOP) arm, affecting Ingram's SQBR.
Robinson-Earl (NOP) releases from Knecht (LAL) as both players come together during the drive and separate.
Knecht (LAL) is retreating his arm into a vertical position and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs with Robinson-Earl (NOP) after his gather.
Christie (LAL) and Nowell (NOP) come together in pursuit of the loose ball. As Christie's right hand gets to the ball, incidental contact occurs with Nowell during the rebound.
Boston Jr. (BOS) commits a take foul on Reaves (LAL).
Missi (NOP) commits a take foul on James (LAL).

events.verdict: Robinson-Earl's (NOP) pass goes out of bounds without being deflected by a defender.
Ingram (NOP) initiates contact with Knecht (LAL) that affects his ability to get to the pass.
